label: pjm 62 coopt deliverable
definition: (PROBE, rejected) pjm 62 coopt deliverable: pjm 61 consolidate config + energy_reserve_coopt with deliverable reserve-supply scoping (pjm_reserve_supply_cap = Σ ramp10[eligible] + pjm_reserve_online_gated ρ=1.0). Measured PJM Primary req (~3.4 GW) vs published two-step ORDC, cleared inside the LP. RESULT: reserve cleared $0 in every hour, so prices are IDENTICAL to the pjm 61 energy-only keeper-candidate (2023 26.42/56.50, 2024 24.89/58.66, 2025 35.06/76.97 avg/max). This is the expected honest confirmation (handoff step 2): the deliverable cap is ~50 GW and online ρ·ΣP is huge — both ≫ the ~3.4 GW requirement on a ~180 GW fleet — because the perfect-foresight LP is not tight when PJM's real RT was tight. The top-tail decompression needs per-gen R[g]≤ramp10[g] (reserve competing with energy on the marginal unit) PLUS commitment tightening, NOT zone-aggregate scoping. Memtest correction: the zone-aggregate co-opt FITS the 15 GB box (~14.5 GB peak/yr), so the doc's prior 'cannot run any co-opt on 15 GB' claim was stale. Nothing fitted to the residual (claude.md #11).
